messages.默认关闭。将 Frame 手柄用作标准游戏手柄；开启后下次打开 APK 生效，必: Off by default. Use Frame controllers as a standard gamepad. Enabling takes effect at the next APK launch and may restart its container. Disabling stops input immediately.
messages.启动台显示时提高界面 CPU 调度优先级，关闭后恢复。: Raise UI CPU scheduling priority while the launcher is visible; restore it when closed.
messages.默认关闭。应用进程连续消失 15 秒后停止容器；切到后台不会停止。: Off by default. Stop the container after app processes are absent for 15 seconds; moving to the background does not stop it.
messages.关闭窗口时停止容器: Stop container when closing its window
messages.收到系统窗口关闭信号后停止容器并保留数据。部分 SteamOS 版本不支持关闭: Stops the container after a confirmed system window-close signal and retains data. Some SteamOS versions cannot close Lepton windows. Background and other shared apps are protected.
messages.默认开启，自动包装已有和新安装的侧载应用。注册不启动应用或重启容器；首次通过 S: Enabled by default. Existing and newly installed sideloaded apps are wrapped automatically. Registration does not start apps or restart containers. Close a running container before its first Steam launch.
messages.等待 Steam 注册，Steam 就绪后会自动重试。: Waiting for Steam registration. It will retry automatically when Steam is ready.
messages.安装前需要关闭容器，以安全备份应用数据。关闭会中断其中正在运行的应用，保留存档和: Close the container before installation to safely back up app data. This interrupts apps running inside it and retains saves and settings.
messages.默认开启，在 Steam 库中保留已安装应用。关闭后只在启动时注册 Steam: On by default. Keeps installed apps in the Steam library. When off, entries are registered at launch and removed after exit; app data is retained.
messages.通过 Steam 启动，可由 Steam 原生关闭窗口。入口是否常驻遵循 APK: Launch through Steam to use its native window-close controls. Entry retention follows the option on the APK Settings page.
messages.Remote game or host is no longer availab: The remote game or host is no longer available. Check the computer connection and try again.
messages.Steam UI operation failed: Steam UI operation failed. Keep Steam awake and try again.
messages.默认关闭。通过 Steam Input 将手柄转发为 Android 标准游戏手: Off by default. Forward Steam Input as a standard Android gamepad, or select Frame direct input. Enabling applies on the next APK launch; disabling stops input immediately.
messages.来源切换需关闭容器后重新启动。Steam Input 使用 Steam 的手柄配: Close and restart the container to change sources. Steam Input uses Steam controller configurations and supports external controllers recognized by Steam.
messages.将游戏的手柄震动反馈回传给当前输入手柄；应用失去 Android 前台状态或手柄: Send game rumble to the current source controller; stop when the app loses Android foreground status or the controller disconnects.
messages.指向可交互控件时振动，不影响 APK 游戏振动。: Vibrate when pointing at interactive controls. APK game rumble is unaffected.
messages.使用 Steam 提示音反馈聚焦和点击。: Use Steam sounds for focus and clicks.
messages.导出本体、插件、渲染及 APK/Lepton 日志和服务状态，不包含插件配置和访: Export Framely, plugin, renderer and APK/Lepton logs with service status. Plugin settings and access password files are excluded.
messages.Android startup timed out; export logs a: Android startup timed out; export logs and retry.
messages.Android PackageManager did not become re: Android PackageManager did not become ready; export logs and retry.
messages.Android user did not unlock; export logs: Android user did not unlock; export logs and retry.
messages.Android external storage did not mount;: Android external storage did not mount; export logs and retry.
messages.Android container stopped before becomin: Android container stopped before becoming ready; export logs and retry.
messages.Android readiness probe did not respond;: Android readiness probe did not respond; export logs and retry.
messages.仅用于部分游戏有声音但黑屏的问题，默认关闭。修改后需重启应用生效，不改变系统驱动: For specific games with sound but a black screen. Off by default. Restart the app after changing this option; system drivers and game files are unchanged.
messages.Framebuffer compatibility runtime is mis: Framebuffer compatibility runtime is missing; install a complete Framely build
